title: Workforce management
summary: Business units, management units, service goals, schedules, adherence, and time off. WFM is a CX 3 capability.

lessons.title: WEM is a set of products, and WFM is one of them
lessons.summary: Recording, screen recording, quality, performance, speech and text analytics, and workforce management are the WEM list.
paras: The WEM article names those capabilities together. WFM is the planning half: business units, management units, service goal templates, planning groups, activity codes, schedules, adherence, intraday, and time off. Quality, recording, and speech analytics are the other half and have their own tracks in this lab.

The overview places WEM on CX 3. A CX 1 org does not grow a forecast by publishing an Architect flow. The Workforce Management certification on the education catalog is the specialist exam for this half, with the WEM – Workforce Management course as the listed preparation.

lessons.title: Business units and management units
lessons.summary: A business unit is the planning container. A management unit is the group of agents you actually schedule.
paras: The WEM article tells you to configure business units and management units before schedules. Agents in a management unit share the planning rules you are about to write. A queue is not a management unit. Queue membership decides who can receive an interaction. The management unit decides who is on the schedule.

Splitting a management unit by every skill creates a puzzle the scheduler cannot solve. The bullseye article’s advice about proficiency groups exists so forecasting and routing describe the same people. If routing uses a skill the schedule has never heard of, the forecast will staff the wrong bodies.

figure.caption: Queue membership and the management unit are different groups.

lessons.title: Service goal templates are the planning target
lessons.summary: The queue’s service level and the WFM template should describe the same promise.
paras: The WEM article lists service goal templates among the objects you configure. The queue article is where the live percentage and target seconds are set, per media. If the template says 80 percent in 20 seconds and the queue says 80 percent in 60, you will staff for one promise and report another.

This lab does not claim Genesys forecasts with Erlang C. Erlang models are classic telephony math. They are not stated in the WEM article. Use the template and the queue’s own target, and treat any external staffing formula as a side calculation you label as such.

lessons.title: Schedules are the plan agents work
lessons.summary: A schedule is built from the management unit, the goals, and activity codes. It is not a routing method.
paras: The WEM article includes schedules and activity codes in the WFM list. Activity codes mark what an agent is supposed to be doing: on queue, break, meeting, training. On Queue, the routing status, is what ACD sees. An activity code that says “on queue” while the agent never selects On Queue is a schedule that routing cannot honor.

Publishing a schedule does not add queue membership and does not change bullseye rings. If the schedule staffs a skill group that is not in the queue, the agents can be “working” and the queue can still starve.

lessons.title: Intraday and adherence compare the plan to the floor
lessons.summary: Adherence is the gap between the activity you scheduled and the status the agent is actually in.
paras: The WEM article lists real-time and historical adherence and intraday monitoring. Intraday is how you change today when the morning forecast was wrong. Adherence is how you see that agents are not in the activity you published. Neither one rewrites Architect.

A queue that suddenly misses service level can be a routing bug or an adherence bug. Check On Queue counts before you add a bullseye ring. If the schedule said twelve and three are On Queue, the ring is not the first lever.

lessons.title: Time off is a schedule change with a rule
lessons.summary: Time-off requests are part of WFM. An approved request that nobody reflects on the schedule is a rumor.
paras: The WEM article lists time-off requests beside schedules and adherence. A request that is approved in mail and never entered in WFM will show the agent as absent against a schedule that still expects them. Adherence will flag them, and the forecast will be wrong.

Time off does not remove queue membership and does not set utilization. The agent who is off should not be On Queue. If they are, routing will still offer them work, and the schedule’s story will be fiction.

lessons.title: The workforce certification is a named exam
lessons.summary: The catalog lists a Workforce Management specialist certification and a preparation course. It does not list a code this lab is willing to invent.
paras: On the Genesys Education cloud exam page, Workforce Management Certification is a specialist exam. The recommended preparation is the course titled WEM – Workforce Management. Professional certification (GC-GCP) is a different exam, prepared by Implementation, Contact Center Administration, and Reporting and Analytics. You can sit more than one. They are not substitutes.

Practice exams exist, 25 to 30 questions, without a voucher, from the announcement page. That practice exam is not this lab’s quiz. This lab’s quiz checks whether you can cite the product. The practice exam is Genesys’ own.
